item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 09/Aug/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure is expected to form over southern China tomorrow and it will bring heavy showers and squally thunderstorms to the region in the next couple of days. With the trough of low pressure weakening slightly, showers will lessen over the coast of Guangdong early next week. Under the influence of a southwesterly airstream, there will still be showers over Guangdong midweek next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Khanun will move across the Korean Peninsula in the latter part of this week. Tropical Cyclone Lan will move towards the seas south of Honshu of Japan in the next few days.
